summary_en: This phase II study looks at PSMA-PET scans and circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) to monitor prostate cancer that has spread to a few sites, after radiation aimed at those sites. Patients receive ablative-intent radiation therapy to all sites of metastatic disease, and some also receive androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) and an androgen receptor signaling inhibitor (ARSI); how often and how long are not stated. The study measures PSMA-PET responses at 6 and 12 months, how they relate to PSA changes and later progression, and ctDNA changes; the primary outcome is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II analiza las imágenes PSMA-PET y el ADN tumoral circulante (ctDNA) para vigilar el cáncer de próstata que se ha extendido a pocos sitios, después de radioterapia dirigida a esos sitios. Los pacientes reciben radioterapia con intención ablativa en todos los sitios de enfermedad metastásica, y algunos también reciben terapia de privación androgénica (ADT) y un inhibidor de la vía de señalización del receptor de andrógenos (ARSI); la frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El estudio mide las respuestas en PSMA-PET a los 6 y 12 meses, su relación con los cambios de PSA y la progresión posterior, y los cambios en el ctDNA; el resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with KPS 70 or higher, or ECOG 0-1.
Biopsy-confirmed castration-sensitive prostate adenocarcinoma with rising PSA.
De novo or hormone-sensitive oligometastatic or oligoprogressive disease with up to five sites outside the pelvis.
Measurable disease and eligible for ablative-intent radiation to all metastatic sites.
Agreement to use effective birth control if of childbearing potential.
not_for: Planning lifelong continuous or intermittent ADT.
More than 3 months of neoadjuvant ADT before consent for the current course.
Polymetastatic or polyprogressive disease, or metastases in brain or liver.
Active HIV, chronic hepatitis B, or hepatitis C infection, unless the listed treatment or viral control conditions are met.
Contraindication to flotufolastat F 18 or PSMA-PET, or other active malignancy that could interfere with study assessments.
